verdict.rationale: The official site links a dedicated 'Migration from Vue 2' resource, so a first-party migration guide for the incompatible Vue 2 to Vue 3 transition exists. The pack shows only its title, though, so its depth is unproven. The releases policy confirms that deprecated features are removed in the next major release, which is why such a guide is needed. Missing for 10: the guide's actual contents (breaking-change list, step-by-step upgrade path, migration tooling), and any independent or hands-on corroboration of its usefulness.

support.subject: As a developer, I can follow a dedicated migration guide when moving between two incompatible major versions of the framework

citations.quote: Deprecated features will continue to work, and will be removed in the next major release after it entered deprecated status.
